guide.title: To your first deal
guide.step.wait.title: Wait for a company to come up for sale
guide.step.wait.hint: Deals come two ways. Sign an NDA on a company put up for sale (a pin on the map), or build a relationship with an owner and propose a deal yourself. Open any company: what to do now is at the top.
guide.step.meet.title: Get to know companies
guide.step.meet.hint: Open a company and meet its owner. At relationship 20 you hear how they feel about selling, at 40 you hear of a sale first, at 60 you can propose a deal even when nothing is for sale.
guide.step.nda.title: Sign an NDA
guide.step.nda.hint: Click a for-sale pin and sign an NDA. The ranges turn into actual figures.
guide.step.diligence.title: Run diligence
guide.step.diligence.hint: Order diligence on the Deal tab. Reports arrive at month-end. Issues you miss surface after the acquisition.
guide.step.committee.title: Structure an offer and take it to IC
guide.step.committee.hint: Set the price and debt, pick a 100-day plan, then submit. Six partners each vote for their own reasons.
guide.step.bid.title: Bid
guide.step.bid.hint: Submit once IC has approved and the sale reaches the bidding stage. The result comes at the deadline.
guide.step.own.title: Win the company
guide.step.own.hint: You need to outbid the rivals, or be the more certain buyer at a similar price.
guide.step.operate.title: Grow the company
guide.step.operate.hint: Set the budget and start initiatives on the Operations tab. Covenants are tested every quarter.
guide.step.exit.title: Sell
guide.step.exit.hint: You can open an exit after 1 year of ownership. Offers arrive in the inbox.
